description: Learn how long an OpenAI-compatible server's vectors are by embedding a probe text; callers should read the solet's dimension through service_interface::embedding_service::get_embedding_dimension.
embedding_description: Measure how long an OpenAI-compatible server's vectors are by sending the probe text 'dimension probe' and counting the numbers returned. Reports the length and model name and spends one real server request. Only for that provider; the solet's own figure comes from its bound service.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Embedding dimension with keys: dimension (int), model (string)
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Determine the appropriate next action based on the context and action result.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Retrieves the vector dimension for an embedding model
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: ConnectionError: API endpoint not reachable. ModelError: Model not available or not found.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: For connection errors: verify the embedding service is running. For model errors: check model name or try listing available models.
